reference.title: A critical evaluation of pressure scales at high temperatures by in situ X-ray diffraction measurements
reference.source: Physics of the Earth and Planetary Interiors

data_license: No separate data license stated; article copyright Elsevier 2004

equation_authority.locations: Equations 1-8 and Table 1; BM3 plus integrated constant-q MGD, 300 K reference

footnotes.MgO: All parameters from Speziale et al. (2001); q=q0*(V/V0)^q1. Adopted comparison scale, not a new Fei EOS. Printed mass heat-capacity coefficient is retained without silently repairing it.
footnotes.Au: All parameters except q from Shim et al. (2002). Fei prints gamma0 error 0.03, whereas Shim Table 1 prints 0.05; retain Fei value and conflict.

isotherm_q_diagnostics.notes: 2127 K is printed in prose but Table 1 and Figure 3 use 2173 K. No continuous q(T) law or errors are supplied; these are local diagnostic estimates, not additional universal EOS records.

source_issues: Page 522 prints annealing at 227 K and 25 GPa; retained as a likely typographical error, not used as a thermal observation.
Table 2 printed Pt outputs differ systematically from the rounded Table 3 parameterization; record and diagnose rather than change published coefficients.
Table 3 3R is a mass-specific coefficient, not the SI molar gas constant. Preserve 0.12500 for Au; it also appears in adopted Shim Table 1.
No objective, covariance, confidence level, or complete upstream shock dataset is supplied.

hirose_selection.rule: All 26 rows of Fei Table 1 plus all 12 hot rows of Hirose Table 1; no Table 2 Au-Pt rows.
hirose_selection.evidence: Hirose page 153 specifies 38 hot observations, Fei simultaneous Au-MgO data at 9-26 GPa and 1273-2173 K. Fei Table 1 has exactly 26 such rows, P=8.64-25.56 GPa; Table 2 is Au-Pt and reaches 28.24 GPa. The 8.64 GPa row must be retained (9 is rounded).
hirose_selection.status: uniquely matched by complete table, paired phases, row count and marginal ranges; no author machine-readable selection file published

figure_only_evidence.Figure 5: Limited W, Mo, Pd, Ag and NaCl comparison observations at 1473 K; no new parameters for these standards, no raw lattice table. See separate plot digitization.
